access_metadata.source_crs: Product ETRS89-LAEA; service EPSG:3857; downloaded EPSG:4326
access_metadata.geometry: Photo-interpreted River_Net_l, Strahler>=3, HYP=1 perennial only; natural N lakes >=0.25km². No reservoirs or guessed width.
access_metadata.attribution: Generated using European Union's Copernicus Land Monitoring Service information; https://doi.org/10.2909/393359a7-7ebd-4a52-80ac-1a18d5f3db9c
access_metadata.historical_applicability: Modern reference; water levels, regulated natural lakes and banks not reconstructed for 1900
access_metadata.persistence: HYP 2 intermittent, 3 ephemeral, 4 dry and unknown omitted. Names identifying the object itself as engineering or a dry channel also excluded; reach endpoints may mention modern dams.
access_metadata.scope: Mainland, Balearics and separate Canary bounded queries; transboundary named main rivers retained to geographic query edges, not clipped at political border.
